Q1.QUESTION: How long does a project take?
Q1.ANSWER: It depends on complexity. A showcase website usually takes 2–3 weeks, while more complex applications may require 1–3 months. After an initial analysis, I always provide a clear timeline.

Q2.QUESTION: How does pricing work?
Q2.ANSWER: After the first contact, I schedule a call to understand your needs. Based on the requirements, I prepare a detailed quote with timelines and costs. Quotes are always free and non-binding.

Q3.QUESTION: Do you offer post-launch support?
Q3.ANSWER: Yes! I offer monthly maintenance packages including updates, backups, performance monitoring, and technical support. Every project also includes 30 days of free post-launch support.

Q4.QUESTION: Do you work remotely?
Q4.ANSWER: Absolutely! I regularly work with clients throughout Italy and occasionally abroad. I use modern collaboration tools to ensure clear and transparent communication throughout the project.

Q5.QUESTION: Which technologies do you use?
Q5.ANSWER: I work with Angular, React, Node.js, TypeScript, SCSS, and many other modern frameworks. Technologies are chosen based on the specific needs of each project.

Q6.QUESTION: Can I get a free consultation?
Q6.ANSWER: Of course! I offer a free 30-minute initial consultation to discuss your project, understand your goals, and evaluate feasibility.
